connectorUiConfig.title: Am I Being Pwned (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
The [Am I Being Pwned](https://amibeingpwned.com/) connector ingests browser extension security events from your Am I Being Pwned organization into Microsoft Sentinel. Am I Being Pwned inventories the browser extensions installed across your company's devices, rates their risk and raises alerts.

The connector polls the Am I Being Pwned events API every five minutes and writes to the `AIBPEvents_CL` table. It collects four event types:

- **alert.raised**: an issue alert about a risky extension (tier `urgent`, `action` or `blocked`).
- **threat.detected**: a malicious or unanalyzable extension was found in your fleet, with how many installs it has.
- **threat.resolved**: a threat was closed (resolved, a false positive, or cleared on its own).
- **device.uninstalled**: the Am I Being Pwned browser agent was removed from a device.

**Prerequisites:**
1. An Am I Being Pwned organization.
2. An organization API key with the `events:read` scope.

sampleQueries.description: Latest Am I Being Pwned events
sampleQueries.query:
{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| project TimeGenerated, EventType, AlertTier, ExtensionName, ExtensionId, Severity, InstallCount, IdentityEmail
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100

{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| where EventType == "alert.raised" and AlertTier == "urgent"
| project TimeGenerated, AlertReason, ExtensionName, ExtensionId, IssueKind, Severity, IssueState, StealsLogins, RemoteCode, InstallCount
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| where EventType == "alert.raised"
| summarize Alerts = dcount(AlertId), MaxInstalls = max(InstallCount) by ExtensionId, ExtensionName
| sort by Alerts desc

{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| where EventType == "device.uninstalled"
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceId, IdentityEmail, Platform
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

columns.description: Stable id of the event. Delivery is at least once: dedupe on it.

columns.name: EventType
columns.description: alert.raised, threat.detected, threat.resolved or device.uninstalled.

columns.name: SchemaVersion
columns.description: The event format's version (2 added affected machines, dashboard links and threat.resolved).

columns.description: alert.raised: id of the issue alert.

columns.name: AlertTier
columns.description: alert.raised: urgent, action or blocked.

columns.name: AlertReason
columns.description: alert.raised: why the alert is at its tier, for example login_theft_running or block_not_applying.

columns.name: ThreatId
columns.description: alert.raised, threat.detected and threat.resolved: the threat, the same id on all three.

columns.name: ExtensionId
columns.description: alert.raised, threat.detected and threat.resolved: the browser extension id.

columns.name: ExtensionName
columns.description: alert.raised and threat.detected: the extension name, when known.

columns.name: IssueKind
columns.description: alert.raised: malicious, vulnerability or unanalyzable.

columns.name: Severity
columns.description: alert.raised: the issue severity. threat.detected: the extension risk rating.

columns.name: IssueState
columns.description: alert.raised: running, block_sent or stopped.

columns.name: StealsLogins
columns.description: alert.raised: the extension can steal logins.

columns.name: RemoteCode
columns.description: alert.raised: the extension can run remote code.

columns.name: InstallCount
columns.description: alert.raised and threat.detected: installs across every inventory source (a machine in two sources counts twice).

columns.name: AffectedMachines
columns.description: alert.raised: machines running the extension, each counted once.

columns.name: Affected
columns.description: alert.raised: up to 50 of those machines: machineName, userEmail, agentDeviceIds, browsers, running, lastSeenAt.

columns.name: DashboardUrl
columns.description: alert.raised, threat.detected, threat.resolved: the threat in the Am I Being Pwned dashboard.

columns.name: Resolution
columns.description: threat.resolved: resolved (a person closed it), false_positive, or auto (no device runs it any more).

columns.name: DeviceId
columns.description: device.uninstalled: the Am I Being Pwned device id.

columns.name: MachineName
columns.description: device.uninstalled: the computer name the deploy script set, when known.

columns.name: IdentityEmail
columns.description: device.uninstalled: the enrolled user's email, when known.

columns.name: Platform
columns.description: device.uninstalled: the device platform.

columns.name: Data
columns.description: The full event payload, the same object a webhook for this event carries as data.

properties.description: AIBP - Urgent extension alert_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.0

Raises an incident for every urgent issue alert from Am I Being Pwned. An urgent alert means a risky browser extension needs attention now, for example an extension that can steal logins is still running in the fleet, or a block that was sent is not taking effect. Each alert id produces one Microsoft Sentinel alert.
properties.query:
AIBPEvents_CL
// Arrival time, not event time: events land minutes after they happen.
| where ingestion_time() > ago(15m)
| where EventType == "alert.raised" and AlertTier == "urgent"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlertId
| extend MalwareName = iif(isnotempty(ExtensionName), ExtensionName, ExtensionId)
// The first two machines and their users, as Host and Account entities
// (a rule maps at most five entities; the extension is the fifth).
| extend Host1 = tostring(Affected[0].machineName), Host2 = tostring(Affected[1].machineName)
| extend User1 = tostring(Affected[0].userEmail), User2 = tostring(Affected[1].userEmail)
| project TimeGenerated, AlertId, AlertReason, ThreatId, ExtensionId, ExtensionName, MalwareName, IssueKind, Severity, IssueState, StealsLogins, RemoteCode, InstallCount, AffectedMachines, DashboardUrl, Host1, Host2, User1, User2

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Am I Being Pwned raised an urgent alert for the browser extension {{MalwareName}} ({{ExtensionId}}) on {{InstallCount}} installs. The reason and state are in the custom details.

properties.description: AIBP - Browser agent removed from device_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.0

Fires when the Am I Being Pwned browser agent is removed from a device. Once the agent is gone, the browser extensions on that device are no longer inventoried or rated, so a removal can hide a malicious extension. Confirm the removal was expected (device retired or reimaged) with the device owner.
properties.displayName: AIBP - Browser agent removed from device
properties.query:
AIBPEvents_CL
// Arrival time, not event time: events land minutes after they happen.
| where ingestion_time() > ago(1h)
| where EventType == "device.uninstalled"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EventId
| extend EnrolledDays = toint(Data.enrolledDays), LastSeenAt = todatetime(Data.lastSeenAt)
// The computer's name when the agent knew it, else our device id.
| extend DeviceLabel = iif(isempty(MachineName), DeviceId, MachineName)
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceId, DeviceLabel, MachineName, IdentityEmail, Platform, EnrolledDays, LastSeenAt

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: The Am I Being Pwned agent was removed from the {{Platform}} browser on {{DeviceLabel}}, used by {{IdentityEmail}}.

properties.displayName: AIBP - Browser agent removed from device

properties.description: AIBP - Malicious extension detected on many devices_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.0

Fires when Am I Being Pwned reports a malicious or unanalyzable browser extension with at least 10 installs across the fleet, either when it is first detected or when a later alert about it shows the higher count. A widely installed bad extension is a fleet-wide exposure rather than a single-device problem. Adjust InstallThreshold to suit the size of your fleet.
properties.displayName: AIBP - Malicious extension detected on many devices

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Am I Being Pwned detected the browser extension {{MalwareName}} ({{ExtensionId}}) on {{InstallCount}} installs. The risk rating and flagged reason are in the custom details.

properties.displayName: AIBP - Malicious extension detected on many devices

properties.description: AIBP - Extensions that steal logins or run remote code_HuntingQueries Hunting Query with template version 3.0.0

properties.displayName: AIBP - Extensions that steal logins or run remote code
properties.query:
AIBPEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventType == "alert.raised"
| where StealsLogins == true or RemoteCode == true
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *), Alerts = dcount(AlertId), Tiers = make_set(AlertTier) by ExtensionId
| project LastAlert = TimeGenerated, ExtensionId, ExtensionName, IssueKind, Severity, IssueState, StealsLogins, RemoteCode, InstallCount, Alerts, Tiers
| sort by IssueState asc, InstallCount desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Lists browser extensions Am I Being Pwned alerted on that can steal logins or run remote code, with their latest state and install count. Use it to find extensions that are still running after a block was sent.

properties.displayName: AIBP - Extensions that steal logins or run remote code

properties.description: AIBP - Browser agent removed soon after enrollment_HuntingQueries Hunting Query with template version 3.0.0

properties.displayName: AIBP - Browser agent removed soon after enrollment
properties.query:
AIBPEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventType == "device.uninstalled"
| extend EnrolledDays = toint(Data.enrolledDays)
| summarize Removals = dcount(EventId), MinEnrolledDays = min(EnrolledDays), Devices = make_set(DeviceId), Platforms = make_set(Platform), LastRemoval = max(TimeGenerated) by IdentityEmail
| where Removals > 1 or MinEnrolledDays < 7
| extend AccountCustomEntity = IdentityEmail
| sort by Removals desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Finds users whose Am I Being Pwned browser agent was removed within 7 days of enrolling, or removed more than once. A user who keeps removing the agent may be avoiding extension monitoring.

properties.displayName: AIBP - Browser agent removed soon after enrollment

properties.description: AIBP - Extension spreading across users_HuntingQueries Hunting Query with template version 3.0.0

properties.query:
AIBPEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where EventType == "alert.raised"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlertId
| mv-expand Machine = Affected
| extend UserEmail = tostring(Machine.userEmail)
| where isnotempty(UserEmail)
| summarize Users = dcount(UserEmail), SomeUsers = make_set(UserEmail, 20), Machines = max(AffectedMachines), LastAlert = max(TimeGenerated) by ExtensionId, ExtensionName
| where Users >= 5
| extend MalwareName = iif(isnotempty(ExtensionName), ExtensionName, ExtensionId)
| sort by Users desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Finds browser extensions that Am I Being Pwned alerted on in the last day and that run for five or more users. One risky extension on many people's machines in a day is usually a campaign or a bad update, not one user's choice.

properties.description: AIBP - Browser agent removed after an alert_HuntingQueries Hunting Query with template version 3.0.0

properties.displayName: AIBP - Browser agent removed after an alert
properties.query:
let Alerted = AIBPEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventType == "alert.raised"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlertId
| mv-expand Machine = Affected
| mv-expand AgentDeviceId = Machine.agentDeviceIds to typeof(string)
| project AlertTime = TimeGenerated, AgentDeviceId, ExtensionName, AlertTier, AlertReason, DashboardUrl;
AIBPEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventType == "device.uninstalled"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EventId
| project RemovedAt = TimeGenerated, AgentDeviceId = DeviceId, IdentityEmail, MachineName
| join kind=inner Alerted on AgentDeviceId
| where RemovedAt between (AlertTime .. (AlertTime + 1d))
| project RemovedAt, AlertTime, MachineName, IdentityEmail, ExtensionName, AlertTier, AlertReason, DashboardUrl
| sort by RemovedAt desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Finds machines whose Am I Being Pwned browser agent was removed within a day of an alert about an extension on that machine. Removing the agent stops extension monitoring there, so right after an alert it can mean someone is avoiding the response.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

The Am I Being Pwned solution for Microsoft Sentinel ingests browser extension security events from Am I Being Pwned: issue alerts about risky extensions, detections of malicious extensions across the fleet, and removals of the Am I Being Pwned browser agent from devices. Analytic rules turn urgent alerts, widespread malicious extensions and agent removals into incidents, and a workbook summarizes alerts, top extensions and agent removals.

Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:

This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in Preview state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs:

  1. Microsoft Sentinel Codeless Connector Framework

Data Connectors: 1, Workbooks: 1, Analytic Rules: 3, Hunting Queries: 4
